build_conda_package: build a conda package for habitat-sim with specified python version and bullet physics variant
get_version_from_pyproject: extract the project version string from pyproject.toml by parsing the version key
get_default_build_matrix: get the default python versions, bullet modes, headless modes, and cuda versions for the current platform
get_platform_string: get the platform string macos or linux based on the current operating system
run_ci_test_build: run a single conda package build for CI testing with python 3.12 and bullet enabled
